about.credits: Built with Python, Dear ImGui (imgui-bundle), moderngl, NumPy, SciPy, Pillow and fast-simplification. Fonts: Noto Sans (OFL). Icons: Font Awesome Free (OFL). Software OpenGL: Mesa llvmpipe (MIT).
about.description: Nimcale turns an image and a height map into a printable 3D relief: coins, medals, plates, tiles and cut-out shapes. Align the texture, shape the relief, sculpt the details and export watertight high-definition meshes for 3D printing or rendering.

fmt.3mf.desc: Modern 3D-printing package in millimeters, opened by PrusaSlicer, Cura, Bambu Studio and Windows 3D.
fmt.gif.desc: Animated 360° turn of the current view, ideal to share.
fmt.glb.desc: Single file with mesh + texture. Great for Blender, web viewers, Windows 3D Viewer.
fmt.gltf.desc: Readable glTF with separate buffer and texture files.
fmt.height_png.desc: The final processed relief as a 16-bit grayscale image (for CNC, laser or other software).
fmt.normal_png.desc: Tangent-space normal map of the relief, for games and renderers.
fmt.obj.desc: Classic format with UVs, material and texture PNG. Opened by almost every 3D program.
fmt.off.desc: Simple text mesh format used by geometry tools (MeshLab, CGAL).
fmt.ply.desc: Binary PLY with per-vertex colors from the texture. Good for MeshLab and full-color printing.
fmt.stl.desc: The standard for 3D printing. Compact binary file, units in millimeters.
fmt.stl_ascii.desc: Text STL: larger files, but readable by any old software.
fmt.texture_png.desc: The aligned texture baked for the plate, as used in the OBJ/GLB exports.
guide.1: Import a texture (color image) and a height map (grayscale: white = high, black = low). You can also drag & drop both files at once onto the window.
guide.2: In the Model tab adjust depth, thickness, smoothing and threshold. Levels, gamma and noise help to refine the relief.
guide.3: In the Shape tab choose a plate or an object cutout, pick an outline (circle, hexagon...) and add a rim or bevel for coins and medals.
guide.4: In the Texture tab switch between texture, height and mix views and align the texture with scale, offset, rotation or Auto-align.
guide.5: Use the Sculpt tab to paint details directly on the model: raise, lower, smooth, flatten or erase. Ctrl+Z undoes anything.
guide.6: Check the real size in millimeters in the Inspector and set the final diameter/width.
guide.7: Export in high definition (millions of triangles, watertight) to STL, 3MF, OBJ, GLB, PLY and more. Save a .nimcale project to continue later.

set.title: Settings
tip.align_keys: Keys: W A S D move, Q / E scale, Z / X width, C / V height (Shift = fine).
tip.anim_bg: Slowly moving purple/pink gradient behind the model.
tip.ao: Darkens cavities to reveal the relief details.
tip.auto_align: Searches the scale and offset that best match the texture edges with the height map.
tip.bevel: Rounds the top edge of the outline.
tip.blur: Gaussian smoothing of the height map, in pixels of the original image.
tip.brush_radius: Ctrl + mouse wheel also changes the size.
tip.check: Verifies that every edge is shared by exactly two triangles (closed, printable solid).
tip.cutout: Removes the background: only the object (above the threshold) becomes solid.
tip.decimate: Reduces the triangle count while keeping the shape (quadric simplification).
tip.depth: Height of the brightest point of the relief above the base.
tip.detail: Sharpens fine details (unsharp mask on the height map).
tip.fit_shape: Measures the object in the height map and fits the outline to it.
tip.gamma: Below 1 lifts the low parts, above 1 accentuates the peaks.
tip.invert: White becomes low and black becomes high.
tip.levels: Height map values below the black point become 0, above the white point become 1.
tip.mesh_res: Number of grid nodes on the longest side for the preview. The HD export is independent of this.
tip.mix: How much texture color is blended with the height shading in mix mode.
tip.neon: Animated glowing borders and highlights. Turn off for a calmer look.
tip.noise: Adds fractal noise for hammered metal or stone looks.
tip.quick_stl: Exports a watertight HD STL with the current quality settings.
tip.rim: Raised border around the outline, like a coin rim.
tip.rim_h: Rim height relative to the relief depth.
tip.size_mm: Real size of the longest side of the plate in millimeters (used by STL/3MF/OBJ).
tip.smooth_edge: Snaps the outline vertices to the exact shape for a smooth edge.
tip.thickness: Thickness of the solid base under the relief.
tip.threshold: Height map values below this become background (object cutout).
